blurb: The public map of Fanout's system design course — deep notes, interview case studies, and from-scratch implementations, read at the source.

adaptedFrom.name: Fanout (Suraj Gaud)
adaptedFrom.note: Fanout publishes no open licence on its site; Sikhi University has Fanout's written permission to build this reading map. No lesson text, video, or diagram is reproduced here — every card opens the real page at fanout.sh. Most of the course's roughly 350 modules, real-world system designs, and case studies sit behind Fanout's paid Pro plans; the pages below are the free public map over that curriculum.

modules.title: The course map
modules.objective: Read the free overview of Fanout's system design course before deciding which paid module to start with.
modules.teach: Fanout's system design course runs in three public parts: fundamentals (requirements through distributed storage and search), real-world systems (a URL shortener through a video platform), and documented case studies (Instagram, Stripe, Discord, Dynamo, GitLab). The overview, roadmap, and resources pages are free; the modules and case studies themselves are Fanout's paid content, priced separately from the AI research course.
